evals.prompt: Audit the visuals of my PixiJS + @pixi/3D game in /root/GAMEDEV and polish it for mid-range Android. Preserve gameplay.
evals.expected_output: A skill-driven run: discovery, baseline screenshot, evidence-backed defect list, art direction, prioritized incremental changes, build/tests, before/after comparison, three quality scores, and clearly separated facts/estimates.

evals.prompt: Review my 3D scene visuals and tell me what looks wrong before I ship.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized visual audit with evidence, severity, root cause, gameplay impact, correction and acceptance criteria for each defect; no fabricated screenshots or metrics.

evals.prompt: My p95 frame time is 45ms on mobile. Optimize the PixiJS renderer but do not break the game.
evals.expected_output: Profile-first investigation, CPU/GPU/memory classification, evidence-supported optimization only, quality/fallback settings, regression testing, and measured before/after numbers with stated device limitations.
